integrity: The proof identifies the triangulation as a quotient of the standard triangular tessellation by the lattice a+3b congruent to 0 modulo n. The short-vector classification is finite and exact, the all-parameter lower bounds are symbolic, and explicit residue-class witnesses attain the second minimum. A standalone standard-library checker replays the short-word classification and finite cyclic complexes for n=17 through 40.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns combinatorial edge length in the Datta--Upadhyay cyclic torus family T_{n,1,3} for n>=17. It does not compare other torus triangulations or geometric flat metrics, and it does not enumerate all carriers at the second independent minimum.
title: A one-direction systolic shell in the cyclic torus family \(T_{n,1,3}\)
